- Removed the skill-card.md file.

Use the verified utilia-solana-agent 0.4.2 release and current wallet-funded MCP integration.
Use the published utilia-solana-agent 0.3.0 npm client for reproducible PDF conversion commands.

- Initial release of utilia-pdf-to-markdown skill.
- Converts public HTTPS PDFs to page-delimited Markdown, with page counts, metadata, and a source SHA-256 digest.
- Requires payment via Utilia's Solana-based x402 client; costs $0.0025 USDC per conversion with a strict $0.01 cap.
- Accepts public PDF URLs only; supports up to 100 pages per document.
- Provides clear instructions for wallet setup, usage, and safety practices.
- Does not support OCR; handles only text-based PDFs.
